title: Remove all music-related features and code

requirements.summary: Delete or fully gut all music-related frontend pages
acceptanceCriteria: No music, playlists, album, or artist detail pages are accessible
App router does not throw errors for removed routes
Navigation links to removed pages are removed from Layout.tsx and Home.tsx

file_operations.description: Delete the Music discovery page that provides multi-source music search with Spotify, YouTube, and SoundCloud integration.
Delete the Playlists management page that allows users to create, rename, delete, and play playlists.
Delete the PlaylistDetail page that shows individual playlist tracks with play-all and remove options.
Delete the song Favorites page that displays user-favorited songs with play-all functionality.
Delete the AlbumDetail page that displays songs for a specific artist/album with play-all button.
Delete the ArtistDetail page that shows artist songs grouped by album with links to album pages.

acceptanceCriteria: MusicPlayer component is no longer rendered anywhere in the app
No SongCard, TrackCard, or AddToPlaylistModal components exist
App.tsx does not import or render any music player or music context

file_operations.description: Delete the persistent bottom music player component with play/pause, skip, seek, volume controls, and YouTube iframe support.
Delete the SongCard component with album art, play/pause toggle, favorite toggling, and playlist modal.
Delete the TrackCard component displaying track title, artist, genre, audio player, and source link.
Delete the AddToPlaylistModal dialog component for adding songs to playlists or creating new ones.
Delete the MusicTickerWidget that displays a scrolling ticker of classical music track names.
Delete the MusicPlayerContext provider managing global music playback state including queue, progress, volume, and YouTube iframe support.

requirements.summary: Delete all music-related services and hooks
acceptanceCriteria: No Spotify, YouTube, or SoundCloud service files exist
useMusicSearch, usePlaylists, useSongFavorites hooks are deleted
useQueries.ts retains only non-music favorites logic, with all song favorites hooks removed

file_operations.description: Delete the unified music API service that aggregates tracks from Spotify, YouTube, SoundCloud, and Jamendo with fallback to static tracks.
Delete the Spotify Web API service using Client Credentials flow to search tracks and retrieve preview URLs.
Delete the YouTube Data API v3 service that searches for music videos and normalizes results into ApiSong objects.
Delete the SoundCloud API service that searches for streamable tracks and normalizes results.
Delete the custom hook for searching and paginating music tracks via music API service with debounced queries and genre filtering.
Delete the React hook providing CRUD operations for user playlists with localStorage persistence.
Delete the React Query hooks for song favorites (get, add, remove) via canister actor.

Remove all song favorites hooks (getSongFavorites, addSongFavorite, removeSongFavorite) from useQueries.ts while retaining the radio station favorites hooks (getFavorites, addFavorite, removeFavorite). Ensure only URL favorites logic remains with proper imports and exports.

acceptanceCriteria: No music.ts, generatedMusic.ts, or fallbackMusic.ts data files exist
No TypeScript errors from missing music type imports remain

file_operations.description: Delete the static data file defining public-domain music tracks with artist info and Internet Archive audio URLs.
Delete the procedural music generation utilities with seed-based functions and large genre-specific data pools for generating fake music metadata.
Delete the curated list of fallback music tracks using public-domain recordings from Internet Archive.
Delete the TypeScript interface definitions for Song and Playlist types used throughout the music feature.

requirements.summary: Update App.tsx, Layout.tsx, and Home.tsx to remove music routing and navigation
acceptanceCriteria: App.tsx has no music, playlist, artist, or album routes
Layout.tsx navigation contains no music-related links
Home.tsx hero/nav cards contain no Music section link
App compiles and runs without errors

file_operations.description: Remove all music-related route definitions (/music, /playlists, /playlist/:id, /artist/:artist, /album/:artist/:album) from the router configuration. Remove the MusicPlayerProvider wrapper and the persistent <MusicPlayer /> component. Remove all imports related to MusicPlayerContext, MusicPlayerProvider, and deleted music pages (Music, Playlists, PlaylistDetail, ArtistDetail, AlbumDetail, Favorites). Ensure the app still renders with Games, Movies, drama pages, AI Assistant, and Personalization intact.

Remove navigation links to Music, Playlists, and Favorites pages from the header navigation. Retain links to Home, Games, Movies, Anime, K-Drama, J-Drama, C-Drama, AI Assistant, and Personalization. Ensure the layout continues to provide the fixed background texture, header navigation, and personalization panel toggle.

Remove the Music section navigation card from the hero/landing page. Retain only the Games and Movies navigation cards. Update any grid layout classes if needed to accommodate two cards instead of three. Ensure the hero banner and overall page styling remain intact.
